strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Software me van sales ki lucat ma wotwot
strings.tierB.home.description: Software pi lupoko jami: invoice ki risit ki i cim pa lacat, jami ma i motoka, coko cente, yo ki limo luwil. Tiyo labongo intanet ci cwalo coc lacen.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Tel lucat ni ma wotwot cakke ki i limo mukwongo nio wa i cente me agikki ma kicoko
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales obedo kabedo me cloud pi kampuni ma poko jami ki ma cato jami madwong (wholesale), ma gitye ki lucat ma wotwot (sales reps). Lucat coyo dok goyo i printa invoice ki risit ki i cim gi, gilubo jami ma tye i motoka dok gicoyo limo, ento ludito neno cut cut jami ma kicato, cente ma kicoko ki banya pa luwil.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Invoice ki i cim pa lacat
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Lacat coyo invoice ka tye i dog ot pa lawil, dok goyo i printa me Bluetooth (thermal) ka pud peya oa ki i duka.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Coko cente ki banya pa luwil
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Cul ducu nongo risit ma tye ki namba, ma kiribo ki invoice ma kiculo kwede, dok banya pa lawil ki ripot me akaunt mere lokke cut cut.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Gwoko jami ma i motoka
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Jami ma i motoka acel acel kilubo gin ki gin: ma kiketo, ma kicato, ma kidwoko ki ma odong, pi meno ka gin mo orweny kineno i nino meno.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Yo ki limo luwil
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Limo acel acel kicoyo ki kabedo, cawa ki cal, dok yo pa lacat acel acel kinyuto i map pi ladit.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Tiyo labongo intanet
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Lucat mede ki cato kadi network pe. Coc kigwoko i cim, ci kicwalo gi kengi ka intanet odwogo, labongo nwoyo.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Dashboard me intanet pi ludito
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Jami ma kicato, cente ma kicoko, jami ma kidwoko, stock ki tic pa lucat i kabedo acel, ki twero pa ngat acel acel ma tiyo ki en.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Wac bot wa kit ma icato kwede
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Kwac quotation nyo yer cawa me cokke. Wa neno lucat ni, yo ma gilubo, jami ni ki gin ma imito i kom invoice.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Yub kampuni ni
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Ket jami, wel gi, luwil ki lucat, dok i settings ket cente ki mucoro pa lobo ni.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Cwal lucat i yo
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Lucat keto app i Android nyo iPhone, gipongo motoka dok gicako cato, goyo invoice ki coko cente.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Lub nino kit ma tye ka wot kwede
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Dashboard me intanet nyuto jami ma kicato, cente ma kicoko, jami ma i motoka ki limo, ka lucat pud gitye i yo.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales obedo kabedo me cloud me telo lucat ma wotwot i kampuni ma poko jami ki ma cato jami madwong. Mako van sales (cato ki i motoka), route sales (cato i yo ma ngene), pre-sales (gamo order mukwongo) ki DSD (tero jami atir i duka). Lucat coyo invoice, goyo i printa, coko cente dok coyo limo ki i cim, ento ludito lubo jami ma kicato, cente ma kicoko, jami ma i motoka ki banya pa luwil i dashboard me intanet.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Eyo. App pa lacat mede ki tic labongo intanet: lacat coyo dok goyo invoice ki risit, coyo limo dok medo luwil manyen, ci gin ducu kicwalo kengi labongo nwoyo ka intanet odwogo. Tye gin acel ma pat i Saudi Arabia: kampuni ma guyabo ribbe ki e-invoicing mito intanet i cawa ma kicoyo invoice nyo coc me jami ma kidwoko.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales tiyo ki kampuni ma poko jami i lobo ducu. Kampuni acel acel keto cente ne ki mucoro i settings ne, dok invoice, risit ki ripot tiyo ki gin. FieldSales tye ki ot madit ne i Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, dok cako tic timme i intanet ki cokke, WhatsApp ki kony ma a ki bor.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: FieldSales ribbe ki yoo me e-invoicing pa gamente?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Wa cwako ribbe ki kabedo Fatoora pa ZATCA i rwom me aryo. Man mako kampuni ma tye i Saudi Arabia. I lobo mukene, kacel ki Uganda ki South Sudan, FieldSales coyo invoice ki cente ni ki mucoro ni, dok ribbe ki yoo me e-invoicing pa lobo meno kinongo ka ikwaco, i nge ka wa neno kacel kwedi gin ma lobo meno mito. I lobo ma pe Saudi Arabia, pe wacikke ni invoice bi lubo cik me e-invoicing pa lobo mo keken.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: App me FieldSales tye i leb mene?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: Nen me app me FieldSales (interface) tye i leb magi keken: leb Arab, leb Muno, leb Faranja, leb Turki ki leb Cina. Pe tye i leb Acoli. Lucat ki ludito twero loko leb me nen, dok invoice ma kigoyo i printa twero bedo ki leb me aryo i ngete leb madit. Pot karatac me website i leb mukene, kacel ki pot karatac man me leb Acoli, kiloko leb gi pi miyo ngec i kom FieldSales keken.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Kwac quotation, yer cawa me cokke nyo coy bot wa i WhatsApp. Wa bi niang kit ma lucat ni tiyo kwede, ci wa konyi keto jami, wel gi, luwil ki lucat. Lucat keto app i Android nyo iPhone, ento ludito tiyo ki dashboard i browser mo keken. Cim me smartphone keken aye jami ma imito.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: Nen me app me FieldSales tye i leb magi: leb Arab, leb Muno, leb Faranja, leb Turki ki leb Cina. Pe tye i leb Acoli. Pot karatac i leb mukene tito FieldSales pi miyo ngec keken.
strings.tierB.category.title: Software me van sales pi lupoko jami | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Software me van sales ki route sales: invoice ma kigoyo ki i cim pa lacat, jami ma i motoka gin ki gin, coko cente ki limo. Tiyo labongo intanet.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Software me van sales (cato ki i motoka) pi lupoko jami ki lucat madwong
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales obedo software me van sales pi kampuni ma lucat gi cato ki i motoka i yo nino ducu. Lacat pongo motoka, cato i duka acel acel, goyo invoice, coko cente dok coyo jami ma kidwoko ki app acel i cim. Ladit neno gin ma kiketo, ma kicato, cente ma kicoko ki gin ma odong i motoka acel acel.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Software me van sales obedo ngo?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Software me van sales, ma kilwongo bene cash van nyo route sales, telo kit me cato ma lacat tero jami i motoka ci cato, tero bot lawil, coyo invoice dok coko cente i limo acel. Ka itiyo ki en, pe dong imito buk me invoice me karatac nyo goyo cim i otyeno. Coyo cato ducu, cul ducu ki jami ducu ma kidwoko macalo coc, pi meno kitwero poro stock ki cente i nino meno. Pi ladit, gamo lapeny adek otyeno ducu: lacat acel acel ocato ngo, ocoko cente adi, dok ngo ma pud odong i motoka acel acel.
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Nino acel i yo
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Nino cakke ki pongo motoka ki i store, dok kicoyo pongo meno. I duka acel acel, lacat yero lawil i app, medo jami ki i list nyo barcode, coyo invoice ci goyo i printa me thermal. Cul kicoyo ki risit, dok jami ducu ma kidwoko kicoyo ki tyen lok ne. I otyeno, gin ma odong i motoka kidwoko i store. I kin tic magi, ladit twero lubo jami ma kicato, cente ma kicoko ki limo pa lacat acel acel i dashboard, labongo goyo cim bot ngat mo.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Kiyubo pi kabedo ma network ne pe tek
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Yo me poko jami kato i te ot, i kabedo me tic madongo ki i gang ma network gi pe tek. App pa lacat me FieldSales gwoko luwil, jami ki wel gi i cim, pi meno lacat twero coyo ki goyo coc labongo intanet. Coc acel acel tye ki lanyut ne kene ma pat, pi meno oo i server tyen acel keken, kadi ka kidwoko cwalo ne tyen mapol. Kampuni me Saudi Arabia ma guyabo ribbe ki e-invoicing mito intanet i cawa ma kicoyo invoice ki coc me jami ma kidwoko. Risit, limo ki luwil manyen pud tiyo labongo intanet pi gin.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Coko cente ki gwoko jami ma i motoka
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Cente ma kitero i yo mito gwoko macalo stock. Cente ducu ma kicoko nongo risit ma tye ki namba, ma kitwero ribo ki invoice ma kiculo kwede, dok banya pa lawil lokke cut cut. Stock ma i motoka kikwano pi jami acel acel: ma kiketo kwanyo ma kicato, medo ma kidwoko ki aloka ma kicoyo, pi meno ludito twero poro ne ki jami ma kikwano i motoka ka lacat pud peya odok paco. Jami ma kidwoko kitwero poko gi: ma ber, ma obale nyo ma kiloko ki mukene, dok ladit aye moko ka gidok i stock ma kitwero cato i motoka.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Pi nga?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales ber pi lupoko jami ki lucat madwong me jami ma kicato oyot calo cam, gin amata, gin me lwoko ki me gwoko kom, ki kampuni mo keken ma tye ki lucat ma limo duka i yo. Cwako van sales, order me pre-sales ki DSD (tero jami atir i duka). Pe obedo ERP ma opong: ribbe ki software me akaunt (accounting) ni nyo ERP ni ki API. Ludito moko gin ma lacat acel acel twero timo, calo miyo discount, cato piny ki wel ma tye i list nyo medo luwil manyen.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Pat ango tye i kin van sales ki pre-sales?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: I van sales, lacat tero jami, miyo, coyo invoice dok coko cente i limo acel. I pre-sales, lacat gamo order, ci store tero ne lacen. FieldSales cwako kit aryo ducu, pi meno kampuni twero tic ki cash van i yo mogo ki gamo order i yo mukene. I kit aryo ducu, invoice, cente ma kicoko ki banya pa luwil tye i software acel, dok ludito neno gi i ripot acel.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Ango ma atimo me poro jami ma i motoka i otyeno?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales nyuto, pi jami acel acel i motoka acel acel, wel ma kiketo, ma kicato, ma kidwoko ki ma odong. Kwan jami ma tye i motoka, ci nen ka wel meno rom ki wel ma odong. Coy pat mo keken macalo aloka ma kicoyo, ci idwok gin ma odong i store i tic acel. Motoka cako nino ma lubo ki akaunt ma leng ma kingeyo.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Lacat me van sales mito jami ango?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Cim me smartphone, Android nyo iPhone. Ka imito, itwero tic ki printa me Bluetooth (thermal): konyo lacat miyo lawil invoice nyo risit ma kigoyo i printa. FieldSales pe cato jami me tic dok pe mito kit printa mo ma pat. Ludito tiyo ki dashboard i browser me kompiuta nyo cim mo keken.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: FieldSales twero ribbe ki software me akaunt mewa?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Eyo. FieldSales miyo API ma weko software me akaunt (accounting) ni nyo ERP ni cwalo ki gamo luwil, jami, invoice, risit ki wot pa stock ki FieldSales. Lutic ni nyo ngat ma ribo yoo gero ribbe meno ki tic ki coc ma tito API.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales i lobo acel acel: cente, mucoro ki e-invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales tiyo pi lupoko jami i lobo ducu. Nen cente, mucoro ki kit me e-invoicing pa lobo acel acel i tebul acel.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales tiyo ki kampuni ma poko jami i lobo ducu. Kampuni acel acel yero lobo ne, cente ki mucoro i settings ne, dok invoice, risit ki ripot lubo gin meno. Ribbe ki e-invoicing pa gamente tiyo i Saudi Arabia keken. I lobo mukene ducu kinongo ka ikwaco. Tebul ma piny nyuto, pi lobo acel acel, cente ma gitiyo kwede, mucoro me cato nyo VAT ma pol kare kitiyo kwede, ki ka ribbe ki e-invoicing pa gamente tye ka tic nyo kinongo ka ikwaco.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Wa cwako ribbe ki kabedo Fatoora pa ZATCA i rwom me aryo
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Kampuni acel acel keto cente ki mucoro i settings ne kene. Mucoro ma i tebul man obedo pi miyo ngec keken dok twero lokke; nen cik ma tye kombedi ki lami tam ni i kom mucoro. Lanyut (—) nyuto ni mucoro ma pol kare kitiyo kwede pe kicoyo pi lobo meno.
strings.tierB.about.title: I kom FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales yubo software me cloud pi kampuni ma poko jami ma gitye ki lucat ma wotwot. FieldSales kicako i 2026 i Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (nying i leb Arab: فيلد سيلز) obedo kabedo me cloud pi kampuni ma poko jami ki ma cato jami madwong, ma gitye ki lucat ma wotwot. FieldSales kicako i 2026 dok tye ki ot madit ne i Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Tiyo ki kampuni i lobo ducu, dok cente ki mucoro pa lobo acel acel kiketo i settings pa kampuni kene. Luwil mewa obedo kampuni ma cato dok tero jami ki lucat ma tye i yo: lupoko jami, lucat madwong ki kampuni ma yubo jami ma gitye ki motoka gi kengi me cato.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Wa yubo software acel ma kiribo kacel pi tic ducu ma i yo: invoice ma kigoyo ki i cim pa lacat, risit ki banya pa luwil, gwoko jami ma i motoka, yo ki limo ki kabedo ki cal, ki dashboard me intanet pi ludito. App pa lacat tiyo i Android ki iPhone dok mede ki tic labongo intanet, ci cwalo coc ka intanet odwogo. Kampuni twero ribo FieldSales ki software me akaunt gi nyo ERP gi ki API, pi meno ngec ma a ki i yo pe mito coyo tyen aryo.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Wa tito software macalo tye. Wa cwako ribbe ki kabedo Fatoora pa ZATCA i rwom me aryo. Ribbe ki yoo pa gamente i lobo mukene kinongo ka ikwaco. Nen me app tye i leb magi: leb Arab, leb Muno, leb Faranja, leb Turki ki leb Cina. Pe tye i leb Acoli. Me lok kwedwa, kwac quotation, yer cawa me cokke nyo coy bot wa i WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Lok ki FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Lok ki lutic pa FieldSales: kwac quotation, yer cawa me cokke nyo coy bot wa i WhatsApp i kom software me van sales ki lucat ma wotwot.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Wac bot wa kit ma lucat ni cato kwede tin ki gin ma imito loko. Kwac quotation, yer cawa me cokke nyo coy bot wa i WhatsApp, ci ngat acel i lutic mewa bi dwoko iri. Pi kony, luwil mewa ma dong gitye twero tic ki yoo magi bene. Konyo ka iwaco lobo ni, wel pa lucat, ki ka gicato ki i motoka, gigamo order, nyo aryo ducu.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Yer cawa me cokke i intanet ki lutic mewa. Wa bi nyuti nino pa lacat i app ki dashboard pa ladit, ki lanen ma cok ki jami ni ki yo ni, dok wa bi gamo lapeny ni i kom cako tic.
